Data completeness: full months, real administrative boundary — 8489 recorded incidents total across 3 months (2026-05–2026-07), queried against Hounslow's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for each month in that window. Day score: 2.3282 weighted incidents/1,000 people, averaged over the last 3 months (92% of the 33-borough average). Night score: 12.9617 weighted incidents/1,000 people, same window (103% of the 33-borough average). Both are normalised by plain 2021 resident population (288,200) — no separate workday/footfall figure exists for Hounslow in the ONS's 2011 workday-population release (the most recent one published), so no correction is applied here (ratio 1.0) rather than guessing one. This means Hounslow's score may be slightly overstated relative to boroughs where a real commuter/footfall correction could be applied — see methodology. Frequently asked questions

Is Hounslow safe?

Based on real, current UK Police data, Wandroz rates Hounslow as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in London during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in London at night, relative to the other London boroughs currently on the automated pipeline. The rating comes from 8489 recorded incidents over 3 months (2026-05 to 2026-07), split into a day-weighted score (property crime) and a night-weighted score (violence, robbery, antisocial behaviour).

Is Hounslow safe at night?

Hounslow's night score is roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in London, based on the categories most relevant after dark (violence, robbery, street theft, public order, antisocial behaviour), normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population rather than plain residents where that data exists, so busy central boroughs aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents.

What official data is Hounslow's rating based on?

8489 recorded incidents from data.police.uk (the UK Police's official open crime API), queried against Hounslow's real administrative boundary and covering 3 months (2026-05 to 2026-07) — recomputed from the source data whenever the Met publishes new months, not a one-off snapshot. Full category breakdown is shown further down this page.
